summary: Frontend mobile Match-3 interaction regression passed on the public Expo preview at 390x844.
critical_code_review_comments: The referenced gameplay implementation uses refs as authoritative state in handleCell, preventing rapid-touch state races.
The board is generated without initial 3+ matches and resolveBoard refills all 49 positions after clears.
No API is used or mocked by this feature.
context_for_next_testing_agent: At 390x844, home loaded, Play Level 1 navigated to a 49-cell board, first tap selected cell 0 with a 3px border, and a rapid valid adjacent swap (12 to 19) produced score 205, moves 19, +205 feedback, and 49 cells. No page error messages or Expo runtime errors were observed.
rca_of_issue: The prior touch race is mitigated by reading selected cell, board, score, and moves from refs inside handleCell and synchronously updating those refs before React state updates. The public-preview regression reproduced the intended interaction successfully.
